# Copilot instructions for this repository

Purpose
- Provide concise, repository-specific guidance for Copilot-powered assistants working on this static portfolio.

Build / test / lint
- No build, test, or lint scripts are present; this is a plain static site (HTML/CSS/JS).
- Local preview (recommended):
  - From repository root: `python3 -m http.server 8000` then open http://localhost:8000
  - Or open `index.html` directly in a browser for quick checks.
- Deployment: GitHub Actions deploys to GitHub Pages on every push to `main` using `.github/workflows/static.yml`. The workflow can also be triggered manually from the Actions tab.

High-level architecture (big picture)
- Single-page static site implemented in `index.html` with styling in `style.css` and asset images in `img/`.
- Navigation is anchor-based (sections in-page): MAIN, ABOUT, SKILLS, PROJECTS, EDUCATION, CONTACT.
- JavaScript is inline in `index.html` and handles:
  - smooth scrolling to anchors
  - scroll position tracking / active sidebar navigation
  - IntersectionObserver-based animations for project cards
  - simple click handlers on `.project-card` elements (they use `onclick` to open project links)
- Styling is driven by CSS custom properties defined at the top of `style.css` (`:root`). Many animations and staggered timings rely on `:nth-child()` selectors and explicit class names.
- Contact data is rendered as a JSON-style terminal inside the `#contact` section (see `index.html`).

Key conventions and repo-specific patterns
- Language: all textual content is in Russian — preserve language when editing copy.
- No bundler or package manager: changes are deployed by pushing to `main`; do not expect `npm`/`yarn` scripts in this repo.
- Profile/contact editing: update the JSON-like block in the `#contact` section of `index.html` (visible in the terminal UI). Lines may change as file edits occur; search for `Contact_Card.json` or the `#contact` id to find it.
- Theme/colors: change visual theme by modifying CSS variables in `style.css` (top of file, `:root`, lines ~1-32).
- Adding a project: add a new `.project-card` element in the Projects section with an `onclick` attribute pointing to the GitHub repo URL; animations expect `.project-card` nodes to exist.
- Skills: skills are grouped into `.skill-category` elements; color-coding and delays often rely on position (`:nth-child()`), so prefer adding a new category node rather than changing selectors when possible.
- Animations & performance: many decorative animations (fish, snowflakes) are implemented with individual DOM elements and keyframes — be careful when changing counts / selectors as timings are often hard-coded.
- Responsive behavior: sidebar navigation is hidden on small screens (media queries in `style.css`); hero layout switches from horizontal to vertical on mobile.

Existing AI assistant configs
- CLAUDE.md is present at the repo root and contains an authoritative project overview and editing notes — consult it for design and content conventions.
- No other assistant config files (.cursorrules, AGENTS.md, CONVENTIONS.md, etc.) detected.

Where to look first for common tasks
- Update profile: search `Contact_Card.json` or open `#contact` in `index.html`.
- Change colors/theme: edit `:root` CSS variables in `style.css`.
- Add projects: edit the Projects section in `index.html` and add `.project-card` nodes with `onclick`.
- Deployment config: `.github/workflows/static.yml` (deploys entire repo to GitHub Pages on push to `main`).

Good prompts for Copilot agents (examples)
- "Find and show the JSON contact block rendered in the terminal in index.html."
- "List all .project-card elements and their onclick URLs."
- "Show CSS variables declared in :root and their current values."

Notes for edits
- Avoid renaming class names or HTML structure used by CSS/JS unless the corresponding CSS and inline JS are updated together.
- Because many behaviors are implemented inline in `index.html`, prefer making small, atomic edits and verifying in a browser (or with a local HTTP server) before committing.
